distractors.reason: We don't say 'do a campaign'. 'Do' is used with tasks and work, like do homework or do the dishes.
We don't say 'take a campaign'. 'Take' is used with photos, breaks or notes.
We don't say 'get a campaign'. 'Get' means to receive or obtain something.

example_sentence: The company will ___ a campaign to promote its new phone.
l1_interference: Türkçe'de 'yapmak' fiili çoğu durumda 'do' ile çevrilir, bu yüzden Türkçe konuşanlar 'do a campaign' diyebilir. Oysa İngilizcede bir kampanya 'run' edilir.
explanation: In English, 'run' is used with campaigns, businesses, tests and services. It means to organize and carry out something over a period of time, which is the normal way to describe advertising campaigns.

related_collocations.example: The brand will launch a campaign next month.
They run an ad on television every evening.
The bright poster attracts attention in the street.

memory_tip: RUN = organize and carry out (a campaign, a business, a test) | DO = perform tasks (homework, work, the dishes)
